contexts.text: The heat of Heaven... is more intense and pure in the Celestial Kingdom...
The Angels... are sometimes in a state of intense love; sometimes in a state of love not intense. HH 159:end.
Provided he intensely longs for his presence...
The things a man views intensely in thought...
When the brain is injured by... too much strain...

What keeps the system of the whole body in expansion and tension but the intension of the mind; and whence comes the intension of the mind but from administrations and works, when they are done from delight.
These lights are many, both as to their degrees of intension, and...
According to the intensions and qualities of the sensations and acts of the body...
The separations... are effected by various degrees of remission and of intension of the Divine proceeding... When this inflows... intensely, the evil are rejected.
When the influx of the Divine is intense...
